description: Query a closed month of the board: the threads that were opened in it, and (with author) one member’s replies as citations with stable cite keys (ba-<id>). The board becomes referenceable as a tool. Only closed months answer — the current month is still being written.

author.description: Optional: exact member name — returns their replies in that month as citations

limit.description: Optional: cap on threads/replies returned (default 25, max 50)

month.description: YYYY-MM — a closed month (anything before this one)

name: board_history
title: history
